newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares close lower on ITC raids.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares close lower on ITC raids.

text.p: Shares on the Delhi bourse closed lower on nervous selling, mainly triggered by raids conducted by income tax officials on the premises of tobacco giant ITC Ltd, brokers said.
The Delhi sensitive index closed 3.87 points lower at 727.33.

"In a lacklustre stock market, the reports of the Enforcement Directorate raiding the ITC Ltd premises nationwide broke the confidence of buyers and investors," said Dilip Pandav of brokers Nidi Investments.
The Enforcement Directorate arrested a director and three former officials of ITC Ltd on Wednesday for alleged violations of foreign exchange rules.
Income tax officials also raided their premises in Delhi, Bombay, Calcutta and Hyderabad.
Officials also summoned ITC chairman Yogesh Deveshwar for questioning on Thursday.
Reliance Industries fell two rupees to 203.25 while ACC gained 12.90 rupees at 1,530.
TISCO fell 3.90 rupees to 182.40 and TELCO quoted six rupees up at 418.
